infer_cf_type_complete.proof: induction H as [...]; for HCF_Rec: infer_rec_type_complete; for HCF_IfThen/IfElse: rewrite IHcond/IHthen/IHelse, destruct sarek_type_eq_dec X X (left branch, right is exfalso); for HCF_For: rewrite IHlo/IHhi/IHbody, two eq_dec self-checks; for HCF_While: rewrite IHcond/IHbody; for HCF_Seq: rewrite IH1/IH2

infer_cf_type_sound.proof: intros env e t H; revert env t H; induction e as [re | cond IHcond then_e IHthen | ...]; for CFRec: infer_rec_type_sound; for CFIfThen/IfElse: destruct cond/then/else results and eq_dec branches, apply HCF_If*; for CFFor: destruct lo/hi/body, apply HCF_For with t_body; for CFWhile: destruct cond/body, HCF_While; for CFSeq: HCF_Seq with t1

infer_constr_type_complete.proof: induction H using has_constr_type_mind with P0 := check_fields ... = inl tt; HCT_Pat: infer_pat_type_complete; HCT_Record: rewrite check IH; HCT_ConstrNone: rewrite lookup hyp; HCT_ConstrSome: rewrite lookup hyp + arg IH + sarek_type_eq_dec pty self; FHT_nil: reflexivity; FHT_cons: rewrite lookup hyp + field IH + sarek_type_eq_dec declared_ty self, exact tail IH

infer_constr_type_sound.proof: induction e using constr_expr_ind_strong; CEPat: infer_pat_type_sound wrapped as CPatternErr; CERecord: destruct check_fields, apply HCT_Record via check_fields_sound; CEConstr: destruct lookup_constr then payload x arg (4-way) — Some/Some uses sarek_type_eq_dec + HCT_ConstrSome with explicit pty, None/None uses HCT_ConstrNone, mixed arities discriminate

infer_fun_type_complete.proof: induction H; HFT_Op: infer_op_type_complete; HFT_App: rewrite IH1/IH2, sarek_type_eq_dec p_ty self reflexivity; HFT_LetRec: rewrite IH1, sarek_type_eq_dec ret_ty self, exact IH2

infer_fun_type_sound.proof: induction e as [oe | fn IHfn arg IHarg | fn_name p_name p_ty ret_ty body IHbody cont IHcont]; FEOp: infer_op_type_sound; FEApp: destruct fn result, destruct tfn to TFun, destruct param list to single p_ty :: nil, destruct arg result, sarek_type_eq_dec targ p_ty, apply HFT_App; FELetRec: destruct body result in extended (p_name,p_ty)::(fn_name,fn_ty)::env, sarek_type_eq_dec tbody ret_ty, apply HFT_LetRec with IHcont on fn-only env

infer_gpu_type_complete.proof: induction H (3 judgement cases); HGT_Special: infer_special_type_complete; HGT_LetShared: ty already TArr _ Shared, simpl exposes the recursive call, exact body IH; HGT_Superstep: rewrite body IH + sarek_type_eq_dec (TPrim TUnit) self reflexive

infer_gpu_type_sound.proof: induction e (3 gpu_expr cases); GESpecial: infer_special_type_sound wrapped as GSpecialErr; GELetShared: destruct ty (only TArr reaches), destruct mem (only Shared), recurse under ((name,ty)::env) via body IH giving HGT_LetShared; GESuperstep: destruct infer body + sarek_type_eq_dec bt (TPrim TUnit), subst, HGT_Superstep via body IH

infer_mut_type_complete.proof: induction H; HMT_Fun: infer_fun_type_complete; HMT_LetMut: rewrite IH1, exact IH2; HMT_Assign: rewrite IH, rewrite lookup hyp, rewrite is_mutable hyp, subst tv, sarek_type_eq_dec tdecl self reflexivity

infer_mut_type_sound.proof: induction e as [fe | name init IHinit body IHbody | name value IHvalue]; MEFun: infer_fun_type_sound; MELetMut: destruct init result, apply HMT_LetMut with t:=tinit using IHinit/IHbody on extended (name,t)::env and name::mu; MEAssign: destruct value result, destruct lookup_env env name, destruct is_mutable mu name, sarek_type_eq_dec tv tdecl, apply HMT_Assign

infer_op_type_complete.proof: induction H; HOT_CF: infer_cf_type_complete; HOT_NumericBinop/IntegerBinop: rewrite IH1/IH2, eq_dec self, destruct op (discriminate non-matching), destruct is_numeric/is_integer eqn (reflexivity or congruence); HOT_BoolBinop: rewrite IH1/IH2, eq_dec self, nested eq_dec TPrim TBool self; HOT_EqBinop: rewrite IH1/IH2, eq_dec self, destruct op (discriminate), reflexivity; HOT_CmpBinop: similar with is_numeric check; HOT_Neg/HOT_Lnot: rewrite IH, is_numeric/is_integer check; HOT_Not: rewrite IH, eq_dec TPrim TBool self

infer_op_type_sound.proof: induction e as [ce | op lhs IHl rhs IHr | op' e' IHop]; OPCf: infer_cf_type_sound; OPBinop: destruct lhs/rhs results, sarek_type_eq_dec t1=t2, then 19-goal destruct op with explicit N-M: goal selectors for NumericBinop/IntegerBinop/BoolBinop/EqBinop/CmpBinop groups; OPUnop: destruct op, Neg: is_numeric check, Not: sarek_type_eq_dec bool check, Lnot: is_integer check

infer_pat_type_complete.proof: induction H using has_pat_type_mind with P0 := check_branches ... = inl tt; HPT_Mut: infer_mut_type_complete; HPT_Match: rewrite scrut IH, lookup hyp, head body IH, rest-check IH; BHT_nil: reflexivity; BHT_cons: rewrite lookup hyp + head IH, sarek_type_eq_dec result_ty self, exact tail IH

infer_pat_type_sound.proof: induction e using pat_expr_ind_strong; PEMut: infer_mut_type_sound; PEMatch: destruct scrutinee result, destruct tscrut keeping only TVariant, inversion on the branch Forall (destruct on the list itself cannot infer the elimination motive), head branch via lookup_constr + IHscrut + Hhead, remaining via check_branches_sound
